reason: Quote states all requests are traced up to a configurable minimum, then a percentage to avoid unnecessary cost, and that the sampling decision and trace ID go in tracing headers named X-Amzn-Trace-Id.

Quote states Transaction Search is an interactive analytics experience giving complete visibility of application transaction spans, and that spans are the fundamental units of operation in a distributed trace.

Quote states that without a policy at endpoint creation Amazon VPC attaches a default full-access policy, and that an endpoint policy doesn't override or replace IAM user or service-specific policies.

The clause that you define an interface VPC endpoint to connect your VPC to X-Ray stands only in the preceding sentence; quote 1 says only 'The endpoint' gives connectivity without IGW, NAT or VPN, and quote 2 says interface endpoints in general use PrivateLink.

The two OPS04-BP05 quotes state distributed tracing monitors and visualizes requests as they traverse distributed-system components, and that teams can better understand how requests flow and where bottlenecks exist.

The REL06-BP07 quotes state the practice of tracing requests through service components to analyze and debug issues, and that AWS X-Ray and CloudWatch Application Monitoring provide a complete view of requests through the application.
